name: brandshield
description: BrandShield AI — AI-Powered Digital Brand Protection Platform

scripts.dev: npm run predev && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.demo: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix server run start" "npm --prefix client run preview"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
